build_alphafold_multimer_model: build a python module to run the AlphaFold-Multimer model with recycling on a protein batch
run_evoformer_embeddings: run the EmbeddingsAndEvoformer module to produce MSA, single, and pair representations from input data
create_template_embedding: create a template embedding from template atom positions and residue types using TemplateEmbedding
sample_msa_sequences: sample MSA sequences from a batch using gumbel argsort sampling with cluster bias
embed_single_template: embed a single template structure into pairwise activations using SingleTemplateEmbedding
